sabrina.name: Sabrina
sabrina.title: Leader
sabrina.backstory: The psychic Gym Leader of Saffron City, Sabrina grew up able to bend spoons and read minds, and learned early that most people prefer you stay quiet about it. She is deadpan, precise and secretly very fond of the dolls she collects. She came to Hollowmere because the street hums with so many unspoken thoughts that, for once, someone can help with them.

design.features: a calm, unblinking gaze and a faint smile that never quite reaches her eyes

sig_sabrina.prompt: a fitted dark red and violet bodysuit with a flowing high-collared cape and a hairband

sp_sabrina.label: Seer's evening wear
sp_sabrina.prompt: a deep plum silk dress with long sleeves and a crescent moon brooch

unique.desc: She reads trouble before it starts, strengthening security and settling pushy clients.

cynthia.name: Cynthia
cynthia.title: Champion
cynthia.backstory: The reigning Champion of Sinnoh, Cynthia has fought, studied and traveled for years chasing legends, and has never once lost her composure while doing it. She digs up ruins in her spare time, is quietly obsessed with old myths, and treats Hollowmere as a fascinating new excavation site. Everyone who meets her seems to want to be near her afterward.

design.hairStyle: very long and sleek, falling over one eye
design.features: a confident, composed face and one eye hidden behind a fall of hair

sig_cynthia.label: Champion's coat
sig_cynthia.prompt: a long black coat with a fur-trimmed collar over a fitted black dress, black boots and a gold hair ornament

sp_cynthia.label: Excavation gear
sp_cynthia.prompt: a tailored khaki field jacket, fitted trousers, gloves and a trowel at her belt

juniper.title: Professor
juniper.name: Aurea Juniper
juniper.backstory: The Unova region's leading Pokémon professor, Juniper is cheerful, brilliant and chronically late, with a lab coat pocket full of sticky notes. She treats everyone as a fascinating specimen to be understood, but she is far kinder than any scientist should be. Hollowmere has turned out to be an excellent field site, and the guests excellent at fieldwork.

sig_juniper.prompt: a long pale blue lab coat over a white blouse and a green knee-length skirt

leaf.name: Leaf
leaf.backstory: A traveling trainer who left her sleepy hometown with little more than a sun hat and a dream of seeing everything, Leaf has crossed regions on foot and made friends everywhere. She turned up in Hollowmere between journeys, looking for coin and a warm bed. She treats every shift like a new route to explore.

misty.title: Leader
misty.backstory: The fiery water gym leader of a small seaside town, Misty set out to prove she was more than her sisters' shadow, and then proved it over and over. She arrived in Hollowmere hunting the best bathhouse in town and took a job on the spot. She has a short temper, a soft heart for water creatures, and a very loyal companion.
